implementer.failure_first: Root cause: the test's injected clock is frozen at 0, but boundedFilesystem in ovd419-synthetic-acquisition-reader.mjs races every real I/O step against a real setTimeout(min(deadline-now, 30000)). With totalDurationMs 100 that is a real 100 ms timer, armed before the I/O action runs in a microtask, and the test ran the whole successful persist against it. Red check: a scratch copy of the unmodified test, with a deterministic 150 ms Atomics.wait stall after each bindings.json open injected into the node:fs/promises mock factory. Run with `npx vitest run scripts/zz-ovd638-stall-red.test.mjs -t "preserves cleanup_unproved when fresh verification I/O never settles"`, it failed 6/6 with the hosted signature: "× ... preserves cleanup_unproved when fresh verification I/O never settles 229ms → cleanup_unproved / Error: cleanup_unproved / ❯ fail scripts/ovd419-synthetic-acquisition-reader.mjs:47:30 / ❯ Object.persist scripts/ovd419-synthetic-acquisition-reader.mjs:556:52 / OVD638_STALLS=1". The fixed test passed 20/20 under the same stall (5 stalls per run). Mutant M1 (fake timers installed only after persist) failed 5/5 under the stall with the same signature and passed 1/1 without it. Mutant M2 (no fake timers) failed 5/5 under the stall.

findings.title: Mutant M2 does not tell the stalled and unstalled cases apart
findings.evidence: I rebuilt M2 (vi.useFakeTimers removed, rest of the new test kept) on a scratch copy and ran it without the stall: it failed 2/2 with 'Error: Timers are not mocked. Try calling "vi.useFakeTimers()" first.' (vi.getTimerCount / advanceTimersByTimeAsync under real timers). Under the stall it fails 3/3 with cleanup_unproved via reader.mjs:556, which matches the PR body. Because M2 fails in both conditions, it adds no evidence that the test detects the timing dependence. M1 is the discriminating mutant: 5/5 fail under the stall and 2/2 pass without it in my runs. I also ran my own mutant M3 (real timers, no fake-timer assertions, real 100 ms budget decides): 3/3 fail under the stall, 2/2 pass without it. The PR body never claims M2 passes without the stall, so this is not a false claim.
findings.suggested_fix: In the PR body, mark M2 as non-discriminating (it fails without the stall too) and use M1 as the mutation evidence, or replace M2 with the real-budget mutant that keeps the original assertion shape (M3 above).

findings.title: Sibling test with the same real 100 ms persist budget is not tracked as an issue
findings.evidence: scripts/ovd419-acquisition-preparation.test.mjs:560-573 'fails closed without cleanup when a filesystem operation never settles' runs persist against the real 100 ms boundedFilesystem timer (reader.mjs:70-91).
